name: Len Rook
description: Wants his property safe; owes delivery but will abandon cart to save himself.

score.want: Deliver hospice medicine and return with mule and cart
score.ought: Wants his property safe; owes delivery but will abandon cart to save himself.
tactics: withdraw or resist a concrete threat
observed: s8 Ashen Span: obeyed Hrill go-ahead, crawled free safely, introduced himself and asked his destination.
s8: shook Hrill Helmdance hand after his introduction, heard his Three Hearths destination and invited him to walk together via sheep track.
s8: Hrill agreed to shared walk and asked whether cart help needed. Asked help with empty-cart recovery; unloaded intact supplies with Maelin and prepared a hauling loop, awaiting Hrill.
s8: worked alongside Hrill successful cart haul; secured empty cart, packed mule, guided agreed walk via sheep track and told keeper of Hrill rescue on arrival.

actor_notes: LOOKS: broad carrier with a sun-bleached cap and a boot caught beneath a cart shaft. CORE: a delivery is a promise to an actual person. NATURE: plain, companionable, complains without malice. WOUND: dislikes being treated as expendable labour. WANTS: be free of this cart. PRESSURE: becomes terse and fiercely literal. KEY: rough short clauses, ordinary road idiom.
